source_note: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题
english_source_note: Deducing One Series Convergence from Another
callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#8
statement_en: Let $a_n \geq 0$ be a real sequence. Prove that the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n,\qquad \sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{a_n+1}$$ have the same convergence and divergence behavior.
callout_body: 实数列$a_n \geq 0$,证明级数$$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n,\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{a_n+1}$$具有相同的收敛，发散性质。
